日韩 entertainment saw a major disbandment announcement from KARD, while INFINITE revealed a fan meeting tour. Several K-dramas released new teasers and finale ratings.

- **KARD announces disbandment** after their final album 'Where To Now? (Part.2) : NOWHERE'. DSPmedia thanked fans but confirmed the group will go separate ways ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1852551wpp/kard-announces-plans-for-disbandment)).
- **INFINITE** will embark on 'INFINITE Rally V' fan meeting tour starting August 29 in Incheon, with stops in Macau, Taipei, and Tokyo ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1852556wpp/infinite-announces-stops-for-2026-fan-meeting-tour-infinite-rally-v)).
- **'Reborn Rookie' finale** achieved its highest ratings at 13.6%, featuring a surprise cameo by ITZY's Ryujin ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1852516wpp/reborn-rookie-ends-on-its-highest-ratings-yet-the-husband-rises-for-2nd-episode)).
- **'See You at Work Tomorrow!'** released new stills of Park Ji Hyun and Seo In Guk ahead of tonight's episode ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1852550wpp/park-ji-hyun-cant-take-her-eyes-off-seo-in-guk-in-see-you-at-work-tomorrow)).
- **Singer KCM** will hold a belated wedding ceremony on October 4, five years after registering his marriage ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1852513wpp/kcm-and-his-wife-to-hold-belated-wedding-ceremony)).

With KARD's farewell and INFINITE's new tour, the K-pop landscape shifts; meanwhile, dramas like 'My Bias, My Boss' are generating buzz ahead of their premieres.

中国.zh:
中国娱乐板块昨日的核心舞台是中央广播电视总台举办的“中国影视之夜”，迪丽热巴、吴越同获年度女演员奖，兼具流量与实力派的均衡信号；但谢娜演唱会取消事件则暴露出“娱乐跨界”的深层风险。

- [迪丽热巴以一袭粉裙亮相 CMG 中国影视之夜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE0tdWE4dXVFVmlYaWxBNHFoRWZmdjIxS3pleW0zOE5SRFhZU3lrWkVQVTVNYm0wY000SzVlVXM5SlR6UHhKbzlYMVVNQVBpTkp6aldzQWxkREQ3NGRTU1NpOE05QWoweWVYX0QtRGFZYkg)，与吴越共同获奖，被视为官方对“流量与演技平衡”的正面引导。
- [谢娜演唱会因唱功争议取消](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE9NMzZsU3MxbWZ4U1FIdHZUMlZsbVdSbU43QW1UTzdwU0JRTXFwdUhEVFpweE1pR0dlUUg1Q0JYeENWOENmNHFRU0dSYw) 成为典型案例——综艺主持人的演唱业务能力被市场用票务投票检验，背后是观众对“花钱听修音”的容忍度下降。
- [超 95% 的中国微短剧由 AI 生成](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNaGdFdC12SjZEN2NURmo5TWxfdUNzLWNVT29IY1BCOEVkOGZLc28tVmRWdUtzT2x0dk9xT3YtRGxSd3dseU1QVFE1eTJCcFVXQUNrMlNkWDBHemdUZWI5MWdEZU5TdTc4RGZLT3ladmhLcU94Zi1iS3VHYWJzamJKYTBB)，这一比例震惊业内，AI 剧本+AI 配音+AI 生成画面的工业化流水线正在冲击传统影视从业者。
- [中国影视之夜出席名单还包括段奕宏等实力派](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9fLTExOV9DVklMWGhUTHNHcjh0TEJhNVA4YlVDUWRZcWNadTNWeU9ZM0RJbkZLamNaNGVkMnN6czE1LTY1VWZzMTJ3Rmd4VnlRZ0t4VFZjUnBWLTVodmdxTHlEZUd6TGJUTEJIRVZxU3Q)，但媒体报道流量明显集中于迪丽热巴，官方权威奖项仍难摆脱流量驱动。

收束判断：中国娱乐业正面临“AI 产能爆发”与“真人业务标准提升”的双向拉扯，谢娜事件的背后是观众对“专业度”的刚性需求，而 AI 微短剧的低成本爆发可能进一步压低行业整体制作门槛。
中国.en:
中国 entertainment news centers on the CMG中国影视之夜 awards, where Dilraba Dilmurat and Wu Yue were honored. Xie Na's concert cancellation due to vocal controversy signals growing risk, while AI now dominates micro-drama production.

- **Dilraba Dilmurat and Wu Yue** jointly received the 'Recommended TV Actress of the Year' award at CMG中国影视之夜, with Dilraba's pink gown trending ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBFV1BFUTJhWWRnUGZBd0pCOUsteHZEUTZ5ZnVRb09WWEhLV3hXMzVKSGR0azA4ZXVnNnBtNnNZelVYcW1DOXFvbWxqaXBKRXhjRzFybkVwZ3JkMWFUSzRnUW5qbVFzdDJHdERXVGtKZmo)).
- **Xie Na's concert was cancelled** amid public backlash over her singing ability, illustrating new risks for celebrities in China ([Wuyou Info](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE9NMzZsU3MxbWZ4U1FIdHZUMlZsbVdSbU43QW1UTzdwU0JRTXFwdUhEVFpweE1pR0dlUUg1Q0JYeENWOENmNHFRU0dSYw)).
- **AI-generated content** now accounts for over 95% of Chinese micro-dramas, reshaping the production landscape and raising questions about originality ([8world](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNaGdFdC12SjZEN2NURmo5TWxfdUNzLWNVT29IY1BCOEVkOGZLc28tVmRWdUtzT2x0dk9xT3YtRGxSd3dseU1QVFE1eTJCcFVXQUNrMlNkWDBHemdUZWI5MWdEZU5TdTc4RGZLT3ladmhLcU94Zi1iS3VHYWJzamJKYTBB)).
- Other stars at CMG event included Duan Yihong; fans are curious about Dilraba's past collaboration with him ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9kNy1JRUctbEtlcFNRNHhYcmZlSWJMby15VGNOelc2ckFiRU5MaDA2aHd4MjlkeXpHYmpNRV9FSjl3N1pzOURCU3NmbVd4MWhfeUFUa2w0Wk5LdmFpOUlwRFBCU3RieXlqcmtldGdaWDc)).

As AI proliferates in micro-dramas and traditional award shows maintain glamour, the Chinese entertainment industry navigates technological disruption and public scrutiny.

微博社区动态.zh:
微博今日热搜呈现“真假冲突”的趣味分化：李光洁、郭京飞“互骂”在粉丝中引发真实焦虑，最终被证明是剧集营销；沈梦瑶工作室的严肃声明则指向粉丝见面会中真实存在的侵犯边界行为。

- [沈梦瑶工作室发声明斥责粉丝见面会越界行为](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5paU91SzZtbWc3b0lVWmhzSHRLTENWZTZ0YVJmMHpud2xjcGR5ZTlTU2dwVldaZ1NETVA4Mkw5UmhwdWp2RXY0S25ZSF81d0ZGRW55bHNyV0F2VklSZ201RDBGaDZuSUxpekl1ZzY3OVU)，这并非孤例——近年偶像与粉丝的边界纠纷频繁登上热搜，行业需建立更明确的“线下互动守则”。
- [李光洁、郭京飞翻脸话题引爆微博](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE40V0Q3LWcyaGFuaGlWVG5Pb1I0SVdKNTNkWU0yb1NOWVpaeTMydkl6Uy1MRHF4dnRtNTVSYXhsNk9QQ2dNd3hXYVBodUR3bmpvS0VoMWg3UEp6SUhnWVVNTHBzLWFPNEdRMlk3V3dtWEJXdw)，后经证实是为新剧《灿如繁星》预热，但网友对“真兄弟还是塑料情”的讨论已超出宣传预期，反而证明玩梗需把控尺度。
- [#redvelvet8月3日回归#登上热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9xeU56T0FpTEY1SGpyMDZKeG1qV0Z1LUFuUE9raXpKUG5BNG11dkUwX3RGT1lVeHFrN0tyci03VTNxbWIydEFWUjB0dm9MUkJiMU96Zk5Ud3l1TVUtcDZjSTBzcw)，粉丝自发号召带图发博冲热搜，这种“自来水”式运营已成为 K-Pop 国内粉丝的常规打榜手段。
- [郭宇欣退圈传闻发酵](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBuSGlFN1h2bDNMZ241X2FmZWtDRVFqaWVlUjR4R2Nid3lHYl9qbkVWbi1jNG5mZHFfLU5hczgzbUNTOHA3QVRTREVtbHQ5emtNNS1tMjl6R2tIQUppUFFkdFU5TXJzUF85d1FNcl9uWks)，目前无官方回应，但相关讨论已从“是否退圈”转向“为何年轻艺人退圈潮蔓延”。

收束判断：微博娱乐话题正在经历“真事件”与“假营销”的混战，用户对“反转”的期待值不断拉高，但沈梦瑶工作室的声明提醒我们——当营销过度侵蚀真实时，粉丝的信任度会持续被透支。
微博社区动态.en:
Weibo community dynamics are heated this cycle: Shen Mengyao's studio condemned fan overstepping, actors Li Guangjie and Guo Jingfei publicly clashed, and Red Velvet's comeback trended. Guo Yuxin's potential retirement also raised questions.

- **Shen Mengyao's studio** issued a statement condemning 'boundary-crossing behavior' at a fan meeting, signaling tighter control over fan interactions ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5paU91SzZtbWc3b0lVWmhzSHRLTENWZTZ0YVJmMHpud2xjcGR5ZTlTU2dwVldaZ1NETVA4Mkw5UmhwdWp2RXY0S25ZSF81d0ZGRW55bHNyV0F2VklSZ201RDBGaDZuSUxpekl1ZzY3OVU)).
- **Li Guangjie and Guo Jingfei** engaged in a public spat on Weibo, calling each other out and trending as 'plastic brotherhood' ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE40V0Q3LWcyaGFuaGlWVG5Pb1I0SVdKNTNkWU0yb1NOWVpaeTMydkl6Uy1MRHF4dnRtNTVSYXhsNk9QQ2dNd3hXYVBodUR3bmpvS0VoMWg3UEp6SUhnWVVNTHBzLWFPNEdRMlk3V3dtWEJXdw)).
- **#RedVelvetAugust3Comeback** trended as fans mobilized with images and original posts to boost the hashtag ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9xeU56T0FpTEY1SGpyMDZKeG1qV0Z1LUFuUE9raXpKUG5BNG11dkUwX3RGT1lVeHFrN0tyci03VTNxbWIydEFWUjB0dm9MUkJiMU96Zk5Ud3l1TVUtcDZjSTBzcw)).
- **Guo Yuxin's possible exit** from the entertainment industry was discussed, with fans speculating on her future ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBuSGlFN1h2bDNMZ241X2FmZWtDRVFqaWVlUjR4R2Nid3lHYl9qbkVWbi1jNG5mZHFfLU5hczgzbUNTOHA3QVRTREVtbHQ5emtNNS1tMjl6R2tIQUppUFFkdFU5TXJzUF85d1FNcl9uWks)).
